snippet.title: Money Lessons From Americans Caring for Aging Parents | Life Lessons | Business Insider
snippet.description:
Sponsored by Edward Jones

Caring for aging parents can be one of the most emotional and financially challenging experiences in adult life — but it can also be immensely rewarding. Four Americans share how they became caregivers to their aging parents, and the lessons learned along the way.

00:00 - Introduction
01:02 - Growing Up With Parents
03:28 - Becoming a Caregiver
05:42 - Financial Cost
07:29 - Scams & Fraud
08:37 - Planning Ahead
12:00 - Emotional Toll
16:03 - Credits

Read "Our neighbors didn't have family, so they became like grandparents to my kids. I still regret that I couldn't help them more than I did": https://bit.ly/3YgkTe4

Read "My mom moved in with me temporarily and ended up staying for 10 years. We split our bills and she helps me with childcare:" https://bit.ly/3Lie34J 

Also read "Our son's family moved in with us a year ago. We were afraid of the toll it would take on our relationships, but it's only made them stronger": https://bit.ly/4awpO1H 

------------------------------------------------------
